exact_statement: For every finite Boolean core g with a source-supporting inherited normalized spectral reference R, the lifted bent carrier preserves this reference under every fair adaptive ordinary physical restriction, including reference-only rows. With K=KL(p_g||R) and M=sum_j h2(Inf_j(g)), K+M plus accumulated actual outcome KL is a supermartingale up to stopping or one final carrier/product conversion, retaining the full terminal H+KL. The least pending booking B obeys B<=M. For the explicit GF(2^l) selector stress family, every l>=2, the total original selector-root pending reserve is at most Wcap=3 for l=2 or 39l/32 for l>=3, and Wcap<13Sbar/48, where Sbar is the one original mean child (4I-H) owner. With unrelated old expenditure at most Sbar/4 and an already booked nested pending reserve theta, top up only Wcap-theta, leaving more than 23Sbar/48 in the same owner. At l=2,3 the complete optional-stop depth-two policy minimum is respectively 47/32-(3/8)log2(7) and 0; it is below Sbar/25 and its increase from depth one is below Sbar/50.
hypotheses: Uniform physical Boolean inputs; entropy, total correlation and KL in bits; actual coherent restriction kernel, extended fairly on source-zero rows.
Carrier F=(-1)^((u+v+L(y)+c)*v)g(y); initial P=p_g(T xor su*L)/4 and Q=R(T xor su*L)/4. R normalized and positive on source support.

Policy chooses only still-unrevealed ordinary core coordinates adaptively, may stop, or query fresh v then convert once to product references. No intermediate reset, no earlier u query, and converted children are terminals.
Quantitative owner comparison is only for h(a,b,x)=psi(a)(1-2*1[x=ab]) on GF(2^l), l>=2, and selector children carrier and carrier*h, using the original uniform product parent reference.

The same original Sbar=2*(3l)+2-H(h)/2 is supplied, with unrelated old expenditure omega<=Sbar/4. Previously allocated theta must be a nested pending booking for the SAME inherited reference and policy class; other consumed debits remain in omega.
Exact depth-two assertions apply only to l=2,3, all distinct first/second ordinary directions and adaptive outcomes, with optional earlier stops/carrier conversions.
